name: gemini-ai
title: Gemini AI
description: A light assistant home screen that turns into a full chat. Expanding rail with recent chats, model switcher and apps launcher; a gradient greeting that sweeps in; four suggestion cards with live mini illustrations; a prompt pill with file chip, a listening mic and send; and streamed replies with a spinning sparkle, code, outline and interactive chart blocks, plus like, dislike, regenerate and copy.
